setting.dshPath.description: Absolute path to the DSH executable on the machine where the extension runs. In a Remote window, set this under Remote Settings. A path unavailable on that host is ignored and DSH is discovered there automatically. For a source checkout, point to the checkout folder or its built apps/cli/lib/bin.js file (a folder is resolved to the built entry automatically); ensure Node.js is installed on that host. Takes effect the next time DSH starts.
setting.themeSync.description: Follow the VS Code color theme into the embedded DSH UI.
setting.completionSound.description: Master switch for DSH session sounds. When off, no session sound plays; when on, each sound is still controlled by its own toggle below.
setting.soundStart.description: Play a sound when a task is picked up and starts (requires the master switch to be on).
setting.soundDone.description: Play a sound when a task finishes (requires the master switch to be on).
setting.soundAsk.description: Play a sound when the harness asks for your input, such as a question or an approval prompt (requires the master switch to be on).
setting.frameFontScale.description: Zoom for the embedded DSH UI content (1 = default size). Lower values make the DSH interface more compact.
setting.localDictation.enabled.descripti: Experimental: transcribe locally with the bundled DSH dictation host and a cached OpenAI Whisper large-v3-turbo model. Disabled by default and supported only on local Apple-silicon macOS and Windows x64.
setting.localDictation.language.descript: Language hint for experimental local dictation.
setting.localDictation.hostPath.descript: Optional absolute override path to dsh-dictation-host. When empty, DSHmux uses its bundled platform runtime.
setting.localDictation.modelPath.descrip: Absolute path to the official full GGML OpenAI Whisper large-v3-turbo model. DSHmux never downloads or copies the model.
setting.localDictation.audioDevice.descr: Optional SDL capture-device number. Leave empty to use the default microphone.
